svg.title: Binoculars dropped from a moving ship
svg.desc: Left: in the ship frame, binoculars fall vertically onto the mast base. Right: in the shore frame, a faded ship marks release and a solid ship marks impact. The binoculars follow a parabola to the advancing mast base. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: One falling object, two reference frames
Constant ship speed, no air resistance: both observers agree on the fall time.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
